lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Prompt engineering la ky thuat thiet ke cau lenh dau vao de huong dan mo hinh ngon ngu lon tao ra ket qua mong muon. Mot prompt tot can ro ngu canh, vai tro va dinh dang dau ra. Viec thu nghiem nhieu cach dien dat khac nhau giup tim ra prompt hieu qua nhat.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Ky thuat few-shot prompting cung cap mot vai vi du mau trong prompt de mo hinh hoc theo mau do. So luong vi du thuong tu 2 den 5 tuy do phuc tap cua tac vu. Few-shot giup mo hinh hieu dung dinh dang ma khong can huan luyen lai.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Zero-shot prompting la khi ta yeu cau mo hinh thuc hien tac vu ma khong cung cap vi du nao. Cach nay phu hop voi cac tac vu don gian ma mo hinh da duoc huan luyen san. Neu ket qua khong tot, nguoi dung nen chuyen sang few-shot hoac bo sung ngu canh.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Chain-of-thought la ky thuat yeu cau mo hinh trinh bay tung buoc suy luan truoc khi dua ra cau tra loi cuoi cung. Ky thuat nay dac biet huu ich voi cac bai toan logic hoac tinh toan nhieu buoc. Viec them cau hay suy nghi tung buoc vao prompt thuong cai thien do chinh xac.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Vai tro he thong system role trong prompt dung de dinh nghia tinh cach, pham vi va gioi han hanh vi cua tro ly AI. System prompt thuong duoc dat co dinh va khong thay doi theo tung luot hoi thoai. Dat system prompt ro rang giup giam tinh trang mo hinh tra loi lac de.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Prompt injection la rui ro khi noi dung do nguoi dung hoac du lieu ben ngoai chua chi dan co gang ghi de len system prompt goc. De giam rui ro, can tach ro vung du lieu va vung chi dan trong prompt. Ngoai ra nen kiem tra va loc dau vao truoc khi dua vao mo hinh.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Temperature la tham so dieu chinh muc do ngau nhien khi mo hinh sinh van ban. Temperature thap gan 0 cho ket qua on dinh va lap lai, con temperature cao tao ra cau tra loi da dang va sang tao hon. Voi cac tac vu can do chinh xac cao nhu tra loi cau hoi, nen dat temperature thap.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Viec chia nho mot prompt phuc tap thanh nhieu buoc nho, goi la prompt chaining, giup mo hinh xu ly tung phan de dang hon. Ket qua cua buoc truoc co the duoc dung lam dau vao cho buoc sau. Cach nay giup giam loi so voi viec yeu cau mo hinh lam tat ca trong mot lan.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: RAG la viet tat cua Retrieval-Augmented Generation, ket hop viec truy xuat tai lieu lien quan voi kha nang sinh van ban cua mo hinh ngon ngu. Thay vi chi dua vao kien thuc da huan luyen, mo hinh duoc cung cap them doan van ban lien quan tai thoi diem tra loi. Cach nay giup giam hien tuong bia dat thong tin.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Buoc dau tien cua mot he thong RAG la chia tai lieu goc thanh cac doan nho goi la chunk. Kich thuoc chunk thuong dao dong tu vai chuc den vai tram tu de vua du ngu canh vua khong qua dai. Moi chunk nen giu duoc y nghia tuong doi doc lap.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Sau khi chia chunk, he thong chuyen moi doan van ban thanh mot vector so hoc goi la embedding. Cac doan co noi dung tuong tu nhau se co vector gan nhau trong khong gian nhieu chieu. Viec luu tru cac vector nay thuong dung co so du lieu vector chuyen dung.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Khi co cau hoi moi, he thong RAG chuyen cau hoi thanh vector roi tim cac chunk co vector gan nhat, goi la truy xuat ngu nghia. Ngoai tim kiem theo vector, co the ket hop tim kiem theo tu khoa de tang do chinh xac. Ky thuat ket hop hai cach nay goi la hybrid search.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Cac doan chunk truy xuat duoc se duoc chen vao prompt cung voi cau hoi cua nguoi dung truoc khi gui cho mo hinh ngon ngu. Mo hinh sau do sinh cau tra loi dua tren noi dung cua cac chunk nay. Viec trich dan ro nguon chunk giup nguoi dung kiem tra lai thong tin.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Mot van de thuong gap trong RAG la truy xuat nhieu, tuc la cac chunk duoc lay ve khong thuc su lien quan den cau hoi. Dieu nay co the khien mo hinh tra loi sai hoac lac de. Viec dat nguong do tuong dong toi thieu giup loc bot cac chunk khong phu hop.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Re-ranking la buoc bo sung sau khi truy xuat ban dau, dung mot mo hinh khac de sap xep lai thu tu uu tien cua cac chunk theo muc do lien quan thuc su. Re-ranking thuong chinh xac hon nhung ton them thoi gian xu ly. He thong co the chi ap dung re-ranking cho mot so luong nho chunk hang dau.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Khi he thong RAG khong tim duoc chunk nao lien quan du tin cay, cach xu ly an toan la tra loi rang chua co can cu trong tai lieu, thay vi tu bia ra thong tin. Day goi la chien luoc fallback co kiem soat. Nguyen tac nay giup tranh hien tuong ao giac gay hieu sai kien thuc.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Tool calling la kha nang cua mo hinh ngon ngu goi cac ham hoac cong cu ben ngoai de lay thong tin hoac thuc hien hanh dong thay vi tu sinh cau tra loi. Mo hinh se chon cong cu phu hop va dien tham so dua tren yeu cau cua nguoi dung. Ket qua tra ve tu cong cu sau do duoc dua lai vao cuoc hoi thoai.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: De mo hinh co the goi cong cu, he thong can khai bao schema cua tung cong cu, bao gom ten, mo ta va danh sach tham so kem kieu du lieu. Mo ta cong cu ro rang giup mo hinh chon dung cong cu trong nhieu lua chon. Tham so nen co vi du minh hoa de giam loi dinh dang.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Mot vong lap goi cong cu dien hinh gom cac buoc: mo hinh quyet dinh goi cong cu, he thong thuc thi cong cu, ket qua duoc tra lai cho mo hinh, va mo hinh tiep tuc sinh cau tra loi hoac goi cong cu khac. Vong lap nay co the lap lai nhieu lan cho den khi hoan thanh tac vu. Can dat gioi han so lan lap de tranh lap vo han.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Function calling la mot dang cu the cua tool calling, trong do mo hinh tra ve mot doi tuong JSON chua ten ham va tham so tuong ung de he thong thuc thi. Dinh dang JSON co cau truc giup lap trinh vien de dang phan tich va goi ham thuc. Nhieu nha cung cap mo hinh ho tro san co che function calling.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Khi thiet ke cong cu cho mo hinh, nen giu moi cong cu don gian va chi lam mot viec ro rang, tuong tu nguyen tac single responsibility trong lap trinh. Cong cu qua phuc tap voi nhieu tham so de khien mo hinh goi sai. Viec chia nho cong cu giup mo hinh ket hop chung linh hoat hon.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Xu ly loi khi goi cong cu la phan quan trong trong he thong tool calling, vi cong cu co the tra ve loi mang, du lieu khong hop le hoac het thoi gian cho. He thong nen tra thong bao loi ro rang lai cho mo hinh de mo hinh co the thu cach khac. Neu khong xu ly tot, mo hinh co the lap lai loi lien tuc.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Mot so he thong cho phep mo hinh goi nhieu cong cu song song trong mot luot de tang toc do xu ly, goi la parallel tool calling. Cach nay phu hop khi cac cong cu doc lap voi nhau va khong can ket qua cua cong cu truoc. Neu cong cu sau phu thuoc cong cu truoc, can goi tuan tu.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Agent la mot he thong su dung mo hinh ngon ngu ket hop tool calling de tu lap ke hoach va thuc hien nhieu buoc nham hoan thanh mot muc tieu phuc tap. Agent thuong co bo nho ngan han de luu lai tien trinh cac buoc da lam. Viec giam sat va gioi han quyen cua agent la can thiet de tranh hanh dong ngoai y muon.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Danh gia mo hinh ngon ngu lon la qua trinh do luong chat luong cau tra loi cua mo hinh theo cac tieu chi nhu do chinh xac, do lien quan va do an toan. Viec danh gia co the thuc hien tu dong bang script hoac thu cong bang con nguoi. Ket qua danh gia giup so sanh giua cac phien ban mo hinh hoac prompt khac nhau.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Golden set la mot tap du lieu mau gom cac cau hoi va cau tra loi dung da duoc xac nhan truoc, dung lam chuan de so sanh voi dau ra cua mo hinh. Golden set can du da dang de phan anh cac tinh huong thuc te. Moi lan thay doi prompt hoac mo hinh, golden set nen duoc chay lai de kiem tra hoi quy.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: LLM-as-judge la ky thuat dung mot mo hinh ngon ngu khac de cham diem hoac so sanh chat luong cau tra loi cua mo hinh dang duoc danh gia. Cach nay giup tu dong hoa viec danh gia o quy mo lon thay vi can con nguoi cham tung cau. Tuy nhien LLM-as-judge cung co the mac sai lam nen can kiem tra cheo dinh ky.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Do chinh xac cua trich dan, tuc citation, la mot tieu chi quan trong khi danh gia he thong RAG, do xem mo hinh co trich dung nguon tai lieu ton tai va dung noi dung hay khong. Mot trich dan bia ra nguon khong ton tai duoc coi la loi nghiem trong. Bo kiem dinh tu dong co the kiem tra citation bang cach so khop voi du lieu goc.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Hien tuong hallucination, hay ao giac cua mo hinh, xay ra khi mo hinh tao ra thong tin nghe co ve hop ly nhung khong dung su that hoac khong co can cu. Danh gia ty le hallucination thuong dua tren viec so sanh cau tra loi voi nguon tai lieu goc. Giam hallucination la mot trong nhung muc tieu quan trong khi xay dung he thong dua tren LLM.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Chi so confidence, hay do tin cay, the hien muc do chac chan cua he thong doi voi mot cau tra loi hoac mot lan truy xuat tai lieu. Khi confidence thap, he thong nen chon phuong an an toan nhu tra loi chung hoac yeu cau them thong tin thay vi dua ra cau tra loi chi tiet co the sai. Nguong confidence cu the thuong duoc xac dinh qua thu nghiem.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Kiem dinh tu dong, goi la validator, la buoc kiem tra dau ra cua mo hinh theo cac quy tac cung truoc khi tra ve cho nguoi dung, vi du kiem tra dinh dang JSON hoac kiem tra trich dan co ton tai hay khong. Neu dau ra khong dat quy tac, he thong co the yeu cau mo hinh sinh lai hoac chuyen sang phuong an du phong. Validator giup tang do tin cay cua he thong trong moi truong san pham thuc te.

lesson: Bai 01 - Nhap mon AI ung dung
text: Danh gia lien tuc, continuous evaluation, nghia la chay lai bo golden set va cac chi so chat luong moi khi co thay doi ve prompt, du lieu hoac mo hinh. Viec nay giup phat hien som cac truong hop chat luong bi giam truoc khi trien khai cho nguoi dung thuc. Mot bao cao danh gia tot nen in ra so lieu tong hop de doc o cuoi.
